层次与深度
Flat
Depth is communicated through flat, border contrast, and reusable shadow or blur treatments. Keep those recipes consistent across hero panels, cards, and controls so the page reads as one material system.
Surfaces should read as flat first, with borders, shadows, and blur only reinforcing that material choice.
技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 0px padding and a 0px radius. Drive the shell with none so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• 间距需对齐检测到的 4px 节奏。
• reuse the Flat surface treatment consistently across cards and controls.
• 圆角需保持在检测到的 9999px 族系内。
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 没有明确理由时，不要超过检测到的极简动效强度。
动效
动效保持克制，以界面为主导，覆盖文字、布局与滚动过渡。 时序主要聚集在 300ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。 悬停行为侧重 透明度 变化。 滚动编排采用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 控制区块显现与节奏。

WebGL
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a full-bleed background field using webgl, renderer, alpha, antialias, DPR 限制, custom shaders. The effect should read as technical, meditative, and atmospheric: dot-matrix particle field with black and sparse spacing. Build it from dot particles + soft depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve reduced motion + dom fallback.

三维引擎
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the 三维引擎 layer as a full-bleed background field 与层叠空间纵深 that feels technical. Use alpha, antialias, DPR 限制 renderer settings, orthographic projection, plane geometry, shadermaterial materials, and 环境光 + 主光 + 轮廓光 lighting. Motion should read as slow orbital drift, with reduced motion + non-3d fallback.
